title: Good writing begins with a clear thought.
excerpt: Choose familiar words. Keep one idea in each sentence. Give your reader a little room to breathe.
content:
## Start with one idea

Before you write a sentence, decide what you want it to say. A clear thought is the beginning of clear writing.

## Keep it simple

- Choose familiar words when they express your meaning accurately.
- Break long sentences where the ideas naturally separate.
- Read your writing aloud to check its rhythm.

## Try it today

Write three sentences about your morning. Then remove any words that do not add meaning.
author: Gurus Classes of English
imageAlt: A writing reminder: clear thoughts, simple words, stronger sentences.
